malice_analysis.why_suspicious: This code is suspicious because it processes the entire decompressed block in a single operation, allocating memory proportional to the uncompressed size without any checks or chunking. malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal decompression routines should process data in small, manageable chunks and enforce resource limits to prevent memory exhaustion. malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate decompression libraries may process large files, but they typically implement chunked processing and enforce limits on memory allocation to prevent abuse. Processing the entire decompressed block in one go without limits is not standard practice.
